structure Mid where
  name   : String
  price  : Nat
  stock  : Nat
  rating : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def CheckInputContract : Contract Input Mid where
  pre  := fun i => i.name ≠ "" ∧ 0 < i.price ∧ i.stock > 0 ∧ i.rating > 0
  post := fun i m => m.name = i.name ∧
                     m.price = i.price ∧
                     m.stock = i.stock ∧
                     m.rating = i.rating

def FinalizeOutputContract : Contract Mid Output where
  pre  := fun m => True
  post := fun m o => o.name = m.name ∧
                     o.price = m.price ∧
                     o.stock = m.stock ∧
                     o.rating = m.rating
